answer: For an agent marketplace, entering a paid discussion thread on violet and juniper surveys could require a hash puzzle tied to the epoch, bidder key and job ID. Validators recompute the hash, enforce a fixed target and reject reused solutions. Allocate jobs in proportion to valid puzzle work, with no account bonus. An operator splitting one computer among aliases gains no extra weight: ten times the expected influence requires ten times the hash attempts, electricity and hardware time. This meters resources; it does not prove personhood.
